title: Console Guided Blend Editor & Simulation Runner for Region/Tier Failovers
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Goal: ship a customer-facing guided editor in Console that lets platform engineers build, validate, and preview routing policies that combine region selection, tier weighting, and automatic fallback to model variants. The feature should reduce manual errors, make failover behavior predictable, and surface cost/latency tradeoffs before deployment.

Scope (MVP):
- Two-pane 'Blend Editor' (visual canvas + editable policy DSL) with synchronized edits.
- Region selector with per-region weight sliders and latency/cost hints.
- Tier routing controls (e.g., live/dedicated/private) and a simple priority matrix.
- Fallback model variant inspector: map primary model -> compatible fallback variants and show expected quality regressions.
- Validation engine that runs static checks and a quick simulation against a small representative traffic sample.
- Preview panel showing: estimated p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, and a trace of a simulated request hitting fallback paths.

Decisions & trade-offs:
- UX: prefer single-screen guided flow over a multi-step wizard to encourage quick iterations; users can open advanced DSL editor for power users.
- Simulation: MVP will use synthetic traffic derived from customer route profiles (no live production traffic) to avoid privacy and safety concerns. Later phases may allow opt-in production-sampled previews.
- Validation coverage: start with high-signal checks (missing fallbacks, circular dependencies, unreachable regions) and add policy lint rules incrementally. Full semantic validation will be handled in engine updates (ENG-1842).

Progress updates:
- 2026-03-02: PM scoping doc created (Confluence) and linked in attachments. Initial IA sketches shared with Design.
- 2026-03-04: Design completed visual language for Blend Editor; provided both a compact canvas and expanded matrix view.
- 2026-03-06: Eng spike (ENG-2987) validated simulation harness feasibility and produced prototype traces.
- 2026-03-08: First working prototype in Console integration branch created; UX microcopy needs review.

Open questions / blockers:
- How to present quality delta for fallback variants when no customer eval data exists? (PM suggested approximate model family degradation bands.)
- Autosuggestion: should Console recommend fallbacks when a model variant is unhealthy? Scope for later.
- Security: since preview may display cost numbers and region-level telemetry, we need a security sign-off (see security_review_required).

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
1) Users can author a routing policy with region weights and tier mapping and save it as a draft.
2) Validation engine surfaces blocking lint errors and warnings inline in the editor.
3) Simulation preview renders estimated latency/cost and a request-level fallback trace for at least three representative scenarios.
4) Editor syncs between visual canvas and policy DSL without losing comments or metadata.
5) Telemetry events emitted for preview runs and save actions for future evaluation.

Follow-ups & future phases:
- Add canary simulation using sampled production traffic (opt-in).
- Add cost-aware recommendations to suggest cheaper model variants when budget constraints are set.
- Extend validation rules to include SLA-aware rollouts and automatic rollback suggestions.
